assumptions.EPE: P1/P2/P2b/P3 use committed Phase3 reconstructed EPE_T for exact reproduction. P4 t0..t3 from cached trajectory and GT; t4 uses historical native final coordinates/native_final_EPE. Threshold disagreement counts in independent_checks.
assumptions.G7: All step effects/intervals computed. Confirmation follows3,2,1,0 and stops at first non-pass. Assessments for shorter steps after stopping are descriptive only.
assumptions.aggregation: P1 primary pooled counts. P2/P2b/P3/P4 non-pose metrics: within-pair -> mean within scene -> equal scenes; pooled proportions separately named. Undefined excludes only its own metric; differences use joint defined pairs.
assumptions.concrete_ties: Only P2b/P3 concrete selection explicitly sorts (-score,parent ID,native ordinal). P3 cutoff groups and selected/excluded members are separately counted.
assumptions.coverage: 32px grid over cached R832 valid image extent, partial boundary cells included. Out-of-rectangle coordinates do not occupy cells but remain in solver population.
assumptions.degenerate_epipolar: Nonfinite epipolar distance caused by degenerate denominator counts as not below threshold and is counted separately; valid coordinate/score/EPE nonfinite values remain faults.
assumptions.native_order: Historical native fine output row order: coarse-window order, then within-window torch.topk(default sorted=True) on native dual-softmax, followed by threshold mask. Original equal-score topk order retained.
assumptions.native_score: src/slim.py:834-904 uses dual softmax(sim_matrix_f), K=int(min(max_fine_matches/M,Lf)), global maximum*fine_match_thres. Phase3 fine recomputed in float32; do not assume identical finite-precision order.
assumptions.pose: Same frozen canonical solver via Phase3 one-seed adapter; 3 CPU workers, one numerical thread each. 500 historical baseline units reused. Whole-scene resampling preserves all methods and five seeds.
assumptions.random_median: 均匀随机选择分布的中位 EPE：每pair每符合主分析的窗口权重1，窗口内每有效候选权重1/v_i；累计权重首次达到50%的误差，再pair→scene汇总。
assumptions.random_seed: Phase3-style SHA256 digest of seed2026, pair_id, purpose='fixed_child_random_prefix', first8 hex -> default_rng permutation. Same permutation prefixes for both budgets. P2b uses exact expectations.
assumptions.retention: Per-pair ceil(rate*all_children) before GT. No-GT children participate in score/selection/pose/epipolar/coverage. Incomplete full-population score invalidates all post-filter metrics for that method/budget.
assumptions.score_arithmetic: head cache is a logit. head_p=expit(float64(logit)). Products use float64, no fitted weights, temperature or thresholds. Exact ties need not all be caused by precision; inherited-parent ties separately counted.
assumptions.statistical_ties: Frozen Spearman/AUROC functions unchanged. Frozen sparsification internally uses score and supplied IDs: the Phase3 encoding of (parent,native ordinal) is preserved. No jitter or extra ranking before metrics. Curves use the same frozen Phase3 order.

initial20_timing.assumption: Fixed spread over scenes, methods/steps, budgets and seeds; geometry-only ETA excludes preparation, I/O and bootstrap.
Fixed spread over scenes, methods/steps, budgets and seeds; geometry-only ETA excludes preparation, I/O and bootstrap.

implementation_incidents.reason: Empty-window aggregate lacked optional window_counts. Fixed aggregate reader; all 100 pair commits reused.
New entry-point bracket syntax error before any geometry call. Fixed, then all modules and critical contracts checked.

resources.scope: System guard samples. Individual geometry child peak RSS not separately instrumented.

limitations: 单训练种子；验证场景参与过BCE-best选轮。
100对、15场景；没有独立数据验证组合分数，预设判据只支持下一步选择。
P2b候选仅限原生已输出子点，不代表所有窗口网格候选。
P4是离线轨迹重放；未实测真实截断GPU延迟、显存或端到端加速。
低纹理仅描述；无定义、几何失败、缺失严格分开。
